changelog:
- Initial release of the sol-email skill.
- Enables automated reading and sending of emails using local himalaya (Maildir) and SMTP.
- Provides script interfaces for inbox reading, sending with attachments, and automated workflows.
- Includes setup instructions, environment variable requirements, example commands, and troubleshooting tips.
- Supports scheduled/automated email checks via cron or OpenClaw integrations.
